sql-query.when: SQL value-versus-grammar contracts, bound parameters, templates, query wrappers or identifiers

structured-query.when: NoSQL/BSON operators, executable predicates, search filters or selector objects

process-code.when: Process launch, shell text, dynamic evaluation or attacker-selected executable

file-network.when: Local file-root guarantees versus caller exposure, archive writes, SSRF, redirects or template-selected files

path-selection.when: Composed root/filename guards, Windows versus POSIX path resolution, prefix boundaries, symlinks and actual check-to-effect applicability

authorization.when: Effective grant/denial composition, server policy, object ownership, tenancy, delegated authority or authenticated connection reuse

credential-lifecycle.when: Issuance, acceptance, recovery, rotation, expiry, consumption or revocation

token-review.when: JWT/session/API-key issuance or acceptance, version-specific signing/verification options, expiry, cached identity, token purpose or revocation

mass-assignment.when: Generic body binding, generated CRUD, privileged fields or sensitive object updates

workflow-state.when: Ordering, alternate branches, payment/approval, quotas, repetition or concurrency

html-output.when: Browser interpretation, HTML trust bypass, stored markup, templates or DOM output

angular-output.when: Angular trust bypasses, pipes, component/template inputs, dialogs or signal bindings

parser-resource.when: Deserialization, XML entities, YAML aliases, archive expansion or parser resource limits

deserialization-libraries.when: Deserialization checks for buffer extents, token validation, work/graph budgets and ecosystem-specific verification

deserialization-native.when: C/C++ decoding, logical input versus SIMD padding/capacity, in-place DOM ownership, pointer aliases after growth, callbacks or parser failure cleanup

deserialization-dotnet.when: .NET decoder readers/resolvers, extension data, logical stream lengths, converter forwarding, metadata/reference handling, population or Type caches

deserialization-java.when: Java decoding, Jackson frontend constraints, duplicate/framing policy, subtype validation, deferred binding or JDK object-input filters

deserialization-javascript.when: JavaScript/TypeScript/TSX decoding, revivers, decoded keys reaching prototype writes, runtime schema/coercion, streaming reparsing or Buffer view ownership

deserialization-python.when: Python decoding, pickle or YAML restoration, JSON/model hooks, framing and integer conversion, alias/work budgets or native buffer views

deserialization-go.when: Go decoding, encoding/json v1/v2 compatibility, merge/error mutation, stream boundaries, custom methods or jsontext state

deserialization-rust.when: Rust decoding, serde_json/Serde visitors, untagged enum replay, allocation hints, recursion, borrowing or feature-specific semantics

deserialization-php.when: PHP decoding, unserialize/session hooks, effective class/depth restrictions, JSON null/error and numeric interpretation, references or extension ownership

deserialization-kotlin.when: Kotlin decoding, platform-specific serializers, polymorphic registrations, defaults/coercion, stream sequences, construction hooks or option forwarding

crypto-configuration.when: Signing/encryption, password hashing, randomness, cookie or CORS settings

native-memory.when: C/C++ bounds, lifetime, ownership or native parser state

rust-security.when: Rust safe APIs, soundness, Cargo features/targets, advisory applicability or source discovery without native candidates

rust-memory.when: Rust unsafe extents/initialization, panic cleanup, Send/Sync, FFI lifetimes, pinning or cancellation

rust-boundaries.when: Rust parser and cumulative resource limits, archive containment, protocol transitions or credential consumers

rust-attack-surfaces.when: Rust application attack scenarios, caller and configuration applicability, or verification of a source candidate
